paired_patients.note: Patients with both Solid Tissue Normal AND Primary Tumor samples. The cleanest paired tumor-vs-adjacent-normal contrast for VAL-120/121/122.

phase_c_paired_qc_passed.note: All 21 paired patients pass the bladder-mucosal-tissue-class CHK-3.1A floor (f_extreme >= 0.387, f_middle <= 0.184) on both samples. See VAL-120/121/122 prereg_amendment_002.md for the floor amendment.

tcga_data_use_notes: TCGA-BLCA is open-access public data from the Genomic Data Commons (GDC).
No biobank application or tier-2/tier-3 controlled-access agreement required.
Sample type, case ID, and sample ID per TCGA Barcode convention; full clinical fields available via GDC API.
For per-patient stage / grade / histology / treatment, query GDC clinical endpoint with case_id list.
